lines.zh: 我在雪原上跑，脚印一串。
lines.en: I run the snowfield, leaving a line of prints.

lines.zh: 我的步子很大，雪被掀起来。
lines.en: My stride is long; snow kicks up.
I keep to the edge of the ice spikes.
Head low, my nose skims the snow.
I pace slowly, broad across the shoulders.

lines.zh: 我踩过一片结冰的水洼。
lines.en: I cross a frozen puddle.
I move through the conifers.

lines.zh: 我停下来，甩掉背上的雪。
lines.en: I stop and shake the snow off my back.
I head up a snowbank.
One step slips; I steady at once.
I follow the mountain's foot. The wind is strong.
Turning, my tail throws up snow.
I move fast, but not in a panic.
I keep to the treeline.

lines.zh: 我坐在雪地上，毛上落着雪。
lines.en: I sit in the snow, flakes on my coat.

lines.zh: 我对着风口呼出一口长气。
lines.en: I breathe a long plume into the wind.
My ears turn toward the trees.

lines.zh: 我舔了两下自己的前掌。
lines.en: I lick my forepads twice.

lines.zh: 我背上的毛被风吹起来。
lines.en: The wind lifts the fur on my back.

lines.zh: 我伏着，只有尾巴尖在动。
lines.en: I lie still; only my tail tip stirs.

lines.zh: 我张开嘴打了个长哈欠。
lines.en: I open my jaws in a long yawn.

lines.zh: 我低头看雪里自己的印。
lines.en: I look down at my own prints.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴在雪上扫出弧。
lines.en: My tail sweeps an arc in the snow.
I am listening to snow fall far off.
I settle down a little.

lines.zh: 我朝风来的方向抬起鼻子。
lines.en: I lift my nose into the wind.
I stand again and shake.
I loll my tongue and pant twice.
I turn my eyes to you. They are bright.

lines.zh: 我看你身上一直在冒热气。
lines.en: I see the steam coming off you.
I come closer and sniff.

lines.zh: 我闻出你身上没有松针。
lines.en: I smell no pine on you.
I sit, my forepaws set side by side.
I tilt my head, as if judging.
I rest a paw on the snow.
I have taken in your scent.
My teeth stay hidden.

lines.zh: 我站起来，绕着你走了半圈。
lines.en: I rise and circle half around you.

lines.zh: 我的鼻息喷在你额头上。
lines.en: My breath puffs against your forehead.
I step back once.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸在你脸前成雾。
lines.en: My breath fogs before your face.

lines.zh: 我朝你轻轻点了一下头。
lines.en: I give you a slight nod.
I wait for you to move.
My tail swings once.

lines.zh: 我退了一步，雪被踩出坑。
lines.en: I step back; the snow pits.
A growl is forced out of my chest.
I lower my head and lick the wound.
Blood mats the fur at my neck.

lines.zh: 我把爪子往雪里陷深了一分。
lines.en: I dig my claws a fraction deeper into the snow.
My breathing is heavier.
I back to a snowdrift.

lines.zh: 肩胛一颤，雪面多了几点红。
lines.en: My shoulder jerks; the snow takes a few red drops.
I lift my head again.
Blood still dripping, I circle half around.
I know the smell of things buried in snow.
I catch it in one bite.
Two chews and it is gone.
I look up at you. More, please.
I lean a little further in.
My forepaw lands on your knee.
This is a little short.
I catch it and barely chew.
I sit, very quiet.

lines.zh: 我鼻尖贴着你手背闻了闻。
lines.en: I press my nose to the back of your hand.
I press my brow into your palm.
I pull back into the snow.
You bump me; I yield half a step.

lines.zh: 我比你重，你没有推动我。
lines.en: I am heavier. You did not move me.

lines.zh: 肩头一偏，我从你旁边过去。
lines.en: I turn my shoulder and pass by you.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，雪被踩实。
lines.en: We collide; the snow packs down.

lines.zh: 我低头看被撞到的那处。
lines.en: I look down at the place you hit.
I shake the snow off.
I go around you and walk on.
I am not cross in the least.
Four feet plant; the snow pits.
I take two more steps into the snow.

lines.zh: 另一只从林线那边跑来。
lines.en: Another comes running from the treeline.
I lick the corner of its mouth.
I lick its ear.
It rests its head against my neck.
We lie down in the snow together.

lines.zh: 它颈侧的毛比我长一寸。
lines.en: The fur on its neck is an inch longer than mine.
We call into the trees together.
It runs first; I follow.
We stop behind a snowbank.
It sleeps beside me.
I take it and set it on the snow.
I sniff. Not edible.
I paw the snow open and press it in.
I carry it two long strides.
I let go; it drops.
I worry it with a forepaw.

lines.zh: 我用鼻尖把它顶到你靴前。
lines.en: I nose it over to your boots.
I study it for a good while.
I leave it on the snow.

lines.zh: 走出三步，我回头瞥了一下。
lines.en: Three steps on, I glance back.

lines.zh: 我的耳朵先转，头才跟上。
lines.en: My ears turn first; my head follows.

lines.zh: 我伏低，尾梢绷成一条线。
lines.en: I flatten down, my tail drawn to a line.
Hind legs load, my forepaws tuck.
I start running at you.
I pick a straight line.

lines.zh: 你的位置定在我眼里了。
lines.en: Your position is fixed in my eyes.
My fur has risen.
Very little lies between us.
I will make no cry.
I have picked up speed.
Snow sprays under my feet.
This time I will hold.
I run after you, fast.
You turn; I cut inside.
I chase low along the snow.

lines.zh: 你放箭，我的步子一步没乱。
lines.en: You shoot; my stride does not break.
I herd you toward the cliff.
I do not shout.

lines.zh: 我把中间这段距离压短。
lines.en: I compress the distance between us.
You can hear my claws.
I am at your left rear; the snow moves.

lines.zh: 你退到雪堆里，走不快了。
lines.en: You back into a drift and slow down.
I pick up a little more speed.
I am nearly on you.
I leap and bite first.
My forepaws land on your shoulder.
I charge and knock you over.
I bite your arm from the side.
That bite closes on air.
One shake of my head throws you down.

lines.zh: 前爪压住你，牙停在你颈边。
lines.en: Forepaws pin you; my teeth stop at your neck.
You catch one blow and lose ground badly.
I spring in once more.

lines.zh: 我咬住你的护腕，往后一扯。
lines.en: I clamp your bracer and haul back.
My teeth are still locked.
The blow misses; I slide half a step out.
I come running from the treeline.
I plant myself in the snow first.
The snow comes over my hocks as I step down.

lines.zh: 我从雪坡后绕出来，肩背一沉。
lines.en: I come around the snowbank, shoulders settling.
There is blood on the wind. Noted.

lines.zh: 远处有响动，我侧过耳朵。
lines.en: Something sounds off; I cock an ear.

lines.zh: 我的体温把脚下的雪化了。
lines.en: My warmth melts the snow underfoot.
I walk two slow steps forward.
I glance into the trees.

lines.zh: 我找到一处能站的地方。
lines.en: I find somewhere to stand.

lines.zh: 我压低身体，等了一会儿。
lines.en: I crouch and wait a while.
I start running across the snowfield.
I plant a foot and look at the treeline.
I start out into the middle of the snowfield.

lines.zh: 火燎到我的毛，雪化了一片。
lines.en: Fire catches my fur; snow melts around me.

lines.zh: 我从岩上摔下，落在雪里。
lines.en: I fall from the rock into the snow.

lines.zh: 水比雪冷得多，我蹬不动。
lines.en: The water is far colder than snow; my legs fail.

lines.zh: 炸开的气把我埋进雪里。
lines.en: The blast buries me in the snow.

lines.zh: 一支箭扎进我后腿的厚毛。
lines.en: An arrow buries in the thick fur of my hind leg.

lines.zh: 那光像针一样扎进骨头。
lines.en: That light needles into my bones.
My legs go soft with an empty belly.

lines.zh: 雷打在我背上，雪都亮了。
lines.en: Lightning hits my back; the snow lights up.

lines.zh: 黑暗里没有雪，也没有地。
lines.en: No snow in the dark. No ground either.
